title: Ring Video Doorbell Wired for $1 with Eligible Device Purchase + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon
body:
Deal: Ring Video Doorbell Wired for $1 with Eligible Device Purchase + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon

[Borg] Cancel or Return it and reorder with a Firestick. Simple, however they were only $39 regular price so you were ripped of if you paid $79. :-)
[Clear] Yes. For most of June nearly all Ring products were 70-90% off. Many, many security cameras too.
[reloxation] Kinda stiff they waited a few days to start this when Fire TV was already on sale. Anyone gonna try and claim after the fact?
[reloxation] Update: I got an $18 gift card from customer service to apply to the doorbell order
[Beauh] Out of stock already…
Damn, was just looking at door camera today.
[reloxation] Still working for me. E.g Fire TV Max + Doorbell = $61
[Captain Hindsight] I used Cashback as well interesting to see if I get anything
[Techefy] No thanks, subscription fees is their business model. One yrs sub will cost u another doorbell
[gcheap] Yep. Maybe worth it if you're just gonna sell it or give it to an enemy.
[bargaino] Meh , for $1 I added to FireTv order. Without subscription:
- its a doorbell - as long as you already have echo devices in the house
- get phone notifications when pressed, and check the video, talk to presser.
Am now part of the Bezos global surveillance network.
Hope this doesn't affect topcashback tracking. The BWS offer was a failure, and i need $10 cashback to get the referral credit. This counts?
[Borg] Of course not as this is wired model, and no ethernet port. Specs clearly note can use existing doorbell transformer if 6–24 VAC or a Ring Plug-In Adapter.
[anamul] Was looking to buy a baby monitor, now got the indoor cam had discount plus the doorbell for a dollaa. Thanks OP
[G0dang] You cannot sideload apps with firestick if anyone didnt know.
